entries.action: Copy-watch — monitor another operator's wallet, copy free mints to astaroth only
entries.reason: Standing rule: free (gas-only) mints execute after a clean preview; paid mints ask first; claims, transfers and sells are never copied. The watch has run since 2026-11-01.

liveDemonstrations.action: Live evaluation against the watched wallet (0x51019FeCA7cb058FA4abE90d71d3289D4835624B)
liveDemonstrations.reason: RESERVE_FLOOR — the watched wallet holds about 0.00008 BNB, below the 0.006 BNB reserve floor, so any live evaluation against it correctly rejects. The APPROVE path is proven by the decision engine's unit tests, not by a live approval against this wallet.

note: Two parts. (1) History: prior on-chain activity by the operator — public transaction hashes that motivated the rulebook. These were the operator's own operations, NOT executions by the code in this repo. (2) Live demonstrations: blocks produced by THIS repo's decision engine, reproducible against the running demo. This repo is standalone: it uses no wallet-agent framework, holds no wallet session, and cannot sign anything. All values are public on-chain data (wallet addresses and transaction hashes). No keys, tokens, or credentials are included anywhere in this file.
